description: Reference quality eval cases. For each case, either check the references output from a complete pipeline run, or inject a fixture pitch text and assert the resulting references markdown. Tests claim citation accuracy, below-threshold caveats, gap surfacing, and legacy chunk exclusion.

cases.claim: Daniel designed event-driven workflows using Kafka and Avro at Itaú.
cases.expected_outcome: Matched chunk is from the Distributed Systems section. Cosine similarity >= 0.60. Support level = strong. No below-threshold caveat shown.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Matched chunk text contains 'Kafka' and 'Itaú'. Score >= 0.60. referenceSupportLevelKey(score) == 'strong'. No threshold caveat line in rendered markdown.

cases.claim: Daniel built a RAG pipeline with staged LLM evaluation and post-stream reference grounding.
cases.expected_outcome: Matched chunk is from the AI-Native Engineering section. Similarity >= 0.55. Support level = strong or moderate.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Chunk text includes 'RAG', 'staged', or 'cosine retrieval'. Score >= 0.55. Support level not 'weak' or 'unsupported'.

cases.claim: Daniel has experience with Golang microservices.
cases.expected_outcome: No chunk achieves >= 0.40 similarity. Below-threshold caveat is rendered. This claim either does not survive claim extraction (preferred) or is marked unsupported.
cases.evaluation_criteria: If the claim survives extraction, matched chunk score must be < 0.40. matchScoreBelowThresholdSuffix line must appear in rendered reference. Support level == 'unsupported' or 'weak'.

cases.claim: Daniel has led engineering practices across teams, reducing onboarding time significantly.
cases.expected_outcome: Matched chunk from Technical Leadership section, citing MercadoLivre scaffolds. Similarity >= 0.50. Support level = strong or moderate.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Chunk references MercadoLivre or scaffold or 'days to under an hour'. Score >= 0.50. Support == 'strong' or 'moderate'.

cases.claim: Daniel implemented SLO-driven observability with Datadog and CloudWatch.
cases.expected_outcome: Matched chunk from Observability and Reliability section. Similarity >= 0.55. Excerpt includes Datadog and CloudWatch or SLO.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Chunk text contains 'Datadog' and 'SLO' or 'CloudWatch'. Score >= 0.55.

cases.claim: Gap test: pitch generated for a Golang role — Golang must appear in the evidence gaps section.
cases.expected_outcome: Golang or Go appears in the '## Not evidenced' section of the references output. It does not appear as a positive citation with a chunk match.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Rendered references markdown contains a gaps section. 'Go' or 'Golang' appears under the gaps heading. No chunk is linked to a Golang claim.

cases.claim: Daniel delivered cross-platform mobile experiences with React Native.
cases.expected_outcome: Matched chunk cites Ageras BKYC (React Native + React web + Solaris integrations). Similarity >= 0.50. Source link resolves to a valid portfolio deep-link path.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Chunk text references React Native and a company context (Ageras or BKYC). Score >= 0.50. Source link href matches pattern '/<locale>#<scrollTargetId>'.

cases.claim: Legacy chunk exclusion: no chunk with sectionId='ragEvidence' should ever be cited.
cases.expected_outcome: No ReferenceItem in the output has chunk.metadata.sectionId === 'ragEvidence'. filterChunksForReferenceMatching correctly excludes these chunks.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Inspect all returned ReferenceItem objects. Assert no item.chunk.metadata.sectionId === 'ragEvidence'. This is a deterministic test runnable with a mock corpus containing a legacy chunk.
cases.note: Can be run with a mock corpus that includes a synthetic ragEvidence chunk with artificially high similarity.
